[center][size=3]Change and improve the design of every map and shape in Pelican with a real rural style and atmosphere, no cliffs, dinamic crops phase and elegant riverbanks.

✔️Enhanced All maps including festivals
﻿﻿✔️ Default Bushes Location
✔️ Dynamic crops phases
✔️ All road structures became dirt
✔️ No lifts blocking the way
✔️ The river bank is more charming
✔️Two additional multi-purpose warehouses
✔️And many more

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tpY0bg7.png[/img]

☑️ The leaves on the road will be there when the weather is sunny, can be activated via confiq.json, Default: false
☑️ All lights throughout the pelican can be turned off
☑️ Shadows for city corners can be activated. Default: False
☑️ All settings can be adjusted using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿﻿﻿[/center]
